follow-up time: Through pregnancy and until 7 days after birth
outcome: Need for respirator treatment in offspring during the first week of life
cohort: 6231 primiparous women with a Finnish background who delivered a singleton between 2009 and 2015 in Vantaa, Finland
finding: Opioid use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk for caesarean sections and the need for respiratory treatment in offspring during the first week of life.
mod_finding: Opioid use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk for caesarean sections.
